import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a comprehensive visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot with size by weight
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                     s=df['weight_grams']/2, 
                     c=df['model_year'], 
                     cmap='viridis', 
                     alpha=0.7, 
                     edgecolors='black', 
                     linewidth=1.5)
for i, brand in enumerate(df['brand']):
    ax1.annotate(brand, (df['megapixels'].iloc[i], df['price_usd'].iloc[i]), 
                fontsize=8, ha='right')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Camera Price vs Megapixels (Size=Weight, Color=Year)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1)
cbar.set_label('Model Year', fontsize=10)

# 2. Brand distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
brand_counts = df['brand'].value_counts()
colors_brand = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(brand_counts))
ax2.pie(brand_counts.values, labels=brand_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=colors_brand, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Brand Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Sensor Type
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax3.barh(sensor_counts.index, sensor_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('muted', len(sensor_counts)))
ax3.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Sensor Types', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Body Type
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
ax4.barh(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('pastel', len(body_counts)))
ax4.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Body Types', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 5. 4K Video capability
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
video_4k = df['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels_4k = ['No 4K', '4K']
colors_4k = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff']
ax5.pie(video_4k.values, labels=labels_4k, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=colors_4k, startangle=90)
ax5.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Weight vs Price
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
colors_brands = sns.color_palette('husl', len(df['brand'].unique()))
brand_color_map = {brand: colors_brands[i] for i, brand in enumerate(df['brand'].unique())}
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax6.scatter(brand_data['weight_grams'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
               label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax6.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Weight vs Price by Brand', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend(fontsize=8)
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 7. Max ISO comparison
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax7.bar(range(len(df)), df['max_iso'], color=sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(df)), 
        edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(df)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(df['brand'], rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Max ISO by Camera', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Timeline of releases
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax8.scatter(df['model_year'], df['price_usd'], s=df['megapixels']*10, 
           c=range(len(df)), cmap='rainbow', alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax8.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Price Trend (Size=Megapixels)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
